comment: Targets of the location sweep (native/tools/rando/location_sweep.py, docs/RANDOMIZER_PLAN.md R2.12). 'kinds' and 'overrides' are hand-written; 'keys' is generated by `location_sweep.py targets` from the disc and the overrides (stage, room, point and layer numbers only). Every location has a kind (R9.1): chest, actr, scob, boss (Dzx keys by field), event, added, code (by key kind); a kind with 'stops' gets its stops per stage from them instead of the disc. overrides.keys may give a key an 'xfail' {tier: reason}.

chest.comment: R2.1: T1 record + live chest per key, T2 opens the chest

actr.comment: R2.2: one run per stop, booted there; the smoke's exit code is the result of the stop's keys

scob.comment: R2.3: one run over the sea rooms on the boat; the per-room check line is the result of the room's keys

boss.comment: R9.1: the 6 boss Heart Containers (BossItem keys). One run per boss room: Bitem for the room's stage and for stage 2 (the sea-stage Helmaroc Bitems), createItemForBoss and the disappear cloud give the seed's item (T1); T2 picks one up. Helmaroc King's sea/Room1 keys are checked from M2tower (point 16: point 0 never finishes loading).

event.comment: R9.1: the 11 event locations (R2.4's evloc smoke): T1 per boot stage reads every event key of the stage back through dEvent_manager_c; T2 plays the key's event (COS_EVLOC_T2) and checks the item it gives. The exit code is the result of the run's keys.

added.comment: R9.1: the 4 chests wwrando adds (R2.10's addchest smoke): T1 per chest stop (with the sites of the same location's room/event edits as hops), T2 opens the added chest. The exit code is the result of the run's keys.

code.comment: R9.1: every Code key (codeloc smoke, one run): the lookups and storage-actor calls give the seed's item. No T2: getting these items means playing the NPC's quest or minigame (talks, letters, auctions, photos), which the sweep cannot drive; the steps' own smokes play the ones they could (codeA's Outset Great Fairy, R2.8's withered tree, R2.9's shops).

xfail.T2: R9.1: the floor in front of the Ghost Ship's chest is not there for the put: the player falls from y -540 to -1630, voids out and the stage reloads (and with the stage's enemies deleted it plays a camera event and reloads too), so the chest is gone. T1 checks the records and the live chests

R9.1: the chest stands on a boulder whose top has no floor where the put stands the player (frontOf finds no ground near the chest's height), so he falls to the beach (y 3426 to 334) and A never says Open. T1 checks the record and the live chest

R9.1: sea room 20 (Fire Mountain) reloads itself about 50 frames after the arrival at point 1 (the room's own respawn), so the chest is gone; from the boat point 100 the put on the lookout platform does not hold (the player drops from y 2500 to 2331). T1 checks the record and the live chest
R9.1: as the other Fire Mountain lookout chest: sea room 20 reloads itself after the arrival at point 1, so the chest is gone. T1 checks the record and the live chest

R9.1: the chest is frozen in ice that only Fire Arrows melt, and Ice Ring Isle (sea room 40) reloads the room soon after the player stands on it (from points 1, 0 and 100, after an unnamed event), so the chest is gone. T1 checks the record and the live chest

R9.1: MiniHyo's only spawn point (room 0, point 0) does not keep the player: about 90 frames after the debug boot (its arrival event ends) the game itself goes back to sea room 40, with no input at all (run.sh run --stage MiniHyo:0:0), so the chest is gone before T2 can walk to it. T1 checks the record and the live chest before that

R9.1: as Ice Ring Isle's cave: MiniKaz's only spawn point (room 0, point 0) sends the player back to sea room 20 by itself about 90 frames after the boot, so the chest is gone before T2 can walk to it. T1 checks the record and the live chest

xfail.T2: evloc cannot play Orca's Hurricane Spin lesson: Link's 006n_talk cut waits for Orca's own message flow (his training state), which an event ordered from the player never starts, so the run times out. T1 checks the placed 011get_item action and the Ji1 code site (codeloc, evloc)

evloc ends Link's 011get_item cut (cut 935) as a stuck staff after the Command Melody cuts it cannot conduct (its own-action exemption compares the cut to the key's global action 957), so execItemGet is not seen; the get-item demo item is the placed one and the save changes. Needs a driver that conducts the Command Melody (as the zephos smoke conducts the Wind's Requiem)
